Riccardo Tammaro 01 / 07

two sides to the story, one person

Hi, I'm Riccardo.

Before every slide, every pipeline and every demo, there's a small-town kid who still gets a little emotional over a sunset and a goal scored in the last minute. Let's start there.

chapter one

A small town, a bunch of friends, a football.

I was born in a small town in Campania, on a little square right in front of the village church, which turned into our football pitch every afternoon. We shouted so loudly that the priest would often come out and ask us to keep it down — and clean up our language. The other team always had one standout player, the one who'd dribble past everyone and go straight for goal: that's where I learned you win when the ball keeps moving and everyone plays as a team.

chapter two

Half marathons and a backpack always ready.

I run because I like testing myself: the discipline of training step by step toward a finish line. A few half marathons behind me, more on the way. And when my legs need a rest, it's time to explore the world: to me, travelling means discovering new places and cultures, keeping an open mind, and measuring myself against ways of living different from my own — that's how you really grow. Mexico, the United States and Hawaii are already checked off, Japan is the next page to write.

chapter three

Guitar in the evening, wrenches on the weekend.

I play just for fun, with zero stage ambitions — purely for the pleasure of it. And when I'm not on the strings, I'm either lost in a good book or bent over a vintage bike I'm bringing back to life — taking it apart, cleaning it up and watching it ride again is a satisfaction all its own.

chapter four

Then, on Monday morning,I switch gears completely.

Same energy, different setting: meeting rooms, calls, events. What never changes is wanting to play the game well.

at work

Enterprise Sales Specialist & Presales at Adobe Italy.

For the past 8 years I've been working across Adobe Experience Cloud — AEM, Brand Concierge, Brand Visibility, GenStudio, Workfront, CSC — helping major Italian organizations in energy, FSI, transportation and public administration understand what I can do for them, what concrete benefits they can expect, and why I'm the right person to talk to.

Riccardo Tammaro

One person, many sides.

Whether it's a half marathon, an enterprise client or a vintage bike to restore, the method stays the same: curiosity, discipline, consistency.
